name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns the constant zero and does nothing else. It is an empty stub in the shared icon.library on the disk.

name: copy_icon_data_to_stack
description: Builds a stack header from a fixed signature and version, copies ten longwords and several icon fields from the caller's structure into local slots, then passes the header to another library routine with the first two arguments. It is library code in icon.library.

name: load_icon_from_info_file
description: Opens the icon's .info file by name, checks its header signature and version, and reads the image and tool-type data into the icon structure, allocating memory for the optional sections. Any failure releases the temporary buffer and returns zero.

name: read_icon_header_sections
description: Checks the icon header signature and version, then reads the optional image and tool-type sections through the library's read calls, allocating memory for each entry. A failed check or read jumps to the common exit, which returns zero.

name: read_icon_extra_sections
description: Reads the remaining optional sections of an icon: a pointer list whose length is counted from the stack, plus a further section read only when its pointer is set. It returns one on success and zero when any read fails.

name: read_icon_pointer_list
description: Fills an array of longwords by reading each entry through the library read call and storing it, decrementing a byte count kept on the stack until it reaches four or less. It then reads an optional trailing section and returns one on success or zero on failure.

name: call_then_return_zero
description: Calls one library routine, discards its result, and returns zero. It is short library code in the shared icon.library.

name: return_without_work
description: Contains only a return and performs no work. It is an empty routine in the shared icon.library on the disk.

name: save_icon_with_buffer
description: Allocates a temporary buffer, reporting an error and returning zero if that fails. Otherwise it writes the icon header and optional sections to a .info file through the library's write calls, restores a saved field, and frees the buffer.

name: write_icon_info_sections
description: Writes the optional image and tool-type sections of an icon to a .info file, measuring each entry before writing it through library calls. It returns one on success and zero on failure.

name: write_icon_extra_sections
description: Writes the remaining optional sections of an icon, including a length-prefixed block when its pointer is set, a pointer list with each entry's length, and a final block, all through library calls. It restores a saved field and returns one on success or zero on failure.

name: write_icon_list_tail
description: Measures the byte length of a null-terminated pointer list by counting its entries, then writes each entry's pointer through library calls, followed by an optional trailing section. It returns one on success and zero when any write fails.

name: write_icon_table_entries
description: Walks a null-terminated table of pointers, writing each entry with its length through library calls, and then writes an optional trailing section. It returns one when every write succeeds and zero otherwise.

name: walk_node_list_until_head
description: Passes each node of a circular list to a library routine, starting after the header node, until the list returns to its head or runs out. It then passes the last node found to the same routine.

name: iterate_linked_list_nodes
description: Passes the current node to a library routine, obtains the next node through another library call, and stops when that call returns nothing or the header link points back to the start. Any remaining node is then passed to the same routine.

name: call_with_offset_pointer
description: Passes its first argument and a second argument moved forward by a fixed offset to another routine, then returns. It is a short forwarding routine in the shared icon.library.

name: allocate_cleared_record
description: Allocates a cleared block of fixed size and stores a pointer to its link field, then passes the record's next field to a routine that fills it. On failure it frees the block and returns zero, otherwise it returns the new record.

name: call_routine_then_return
description: Calls one library routine with no arguments and returns. It is a minimal forwarding routine in the shared icon.library.

name: return_constant_zero
description: Returns the constant zero without calling any routine or touching its arguments. It is library code in the shared icon.library on the disk.

name: store_pair_in_table_entry
description: Decrements a 16-bit count and, when it runs out, asks a library routine to expand the table. It then stores two longwords into the slot selected by the count and returns one, or zero if the expansion fails.

name: decrement_counter_and_store_pair
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter through its pointer, then stores two values from registers into consecutive entries of the table referenced by a field of the structure, selected by the new counter. It returns one.

name: allocate_and_link_record
description: Allocates a cleared record and stores a pointer to its second field, then passes the record through two library routines that set it up from the caller's arguments. On any failure it frees the record and returns zero; otherwise it returns the record.

name: return_immediately_empty
description: Contains only a return, with no work and no calls. It is an empty routine in the shared icon.library on the disk.

name: call_routine_return_zero
description: Calls one library routine and then returns the constant zero, ignoring the routine's result. It is short library code in the shared icon.library.

name: advance_pointer_and_call
description: Passes its first argument and the second argument advanced by a fixed step to another routine, then returns. It forwards the call without any work of its own.

name: find_tooltype_value
description: Converts a base value through a library routine, then searches a null-terminated list of entries for one whose text is followed by an equals sign, and returns a pointer to the value after that sign. It returns zero when no entry matches.

name: locate_value_after_equals
description: Walks a null-terminated list of pointers and checks each entry at a selected position, returning the text after the equals sign once a library routine reports success. It returns zero when the list ends first.

name: find_entry_value_after_equals
description: Walks a null-terminated list of pointers, passing each entry to a library routine, and returns the text after the equals sign at the offset of the first entry for which that routine returns zero. It returns zero when the list ends.

name: match_segment_in_list
description: Walks a string of entries separated by a delimiter character, locating each separator through a library call and comparing each segment's length with a reference value. When a length matches and a library routine confirms the segment, it returns one; it returns zero when the entries run out.

name: find_matching_segment
description: Steps through separator-delimited entries with a library routine, returning one when an entry's length equals the reference value and a second library call confirms it. It returns zero when the entries are exhausted.

name: scan_delimited_segments
description: Steps through separator-delimited segments, comparing each segment's length with a reference value and confirming a match through a library routine. It returns one on success and zero when the segments are used up.

name: scan_segments_for_length
description: Walks delimiter-separated segments and returns one as soon as a segment has the expected length and the confirming library routine reports zero. If no segment qualifies, it returns zero.

name: find_segment_with_length
description: Iterates over delimiter-separated segments, using library calls to find each separator and to test the segment length. It returns one for the first qualifying segment and zero when none is left.

name: parse_copy_count_text
description: Parses a text field that starts with a fixed copy phrase, reads a decimal count from it, and records that count with the text that follows in the structure. If the phrase is missing, it stores a count of one and uses a different text offset instead.

name: parse_prefixed_decimal_field
description: Checks a three-character prefix at a fixed position, then reads the decimal digits after it and checks a further four-character tag. It finishes by calling two library routines that record the outcome.

name: parse_decimal_digits_then_tag
description: Reads decimal digits from a string into a numeric value, then checks a four-character tag that follows them. It then calls two library routines to record whether the parse succeeded.

name: parse_decimal_count_suffix
description: Accumulates decimal digits from a string into a count, then checks the four characters that follow against a text constant. It calls two library routines to finish the parse whether or not the check passes.

name: convert_decimal_digit_char
description: Returns the numeric value of a character when it is a decimal digit, and minus one for any other character. It is a small conversion routine in the shared icon.library.

name: return_minus_one
description: Returns minus one without doing anything else. It is an empty stub in the shared icon.library on the disk.

name: call_library_function_and_return
description: Calls one function of a library whose base is held in a global variable, passing no arguments, and then returns. It forwards the call to the library without any work of its own.

name: call_second_library_function
description: Calls a different library function through the same global library base, with no arguments, and then returns. It is a minimal forwarding routine in icon.library.

name: attempt_and_release_on_failure
description: Obtains a value from a routine using the last two arguments, then passes it with the first two arguments to a second routine. If that second step fails, it releases the value through another routine and returns zero; otherwise it returns the value.

name: allocate_block_with_default_count
description: Allocates a cleared block, stores a default count of ten in the block and in the caller's word, and passes the caller's buffer and the new block to a library routine. It returns one on success and zero when the allocation fails.

name: return_zero_value_only
description: Returns the constant zero and nothing else. It is a trivial routine in the shared icon.library on the disk.

name: verify_library_result_or_zero
description: Calls a library routine with three arguments and returns the fourth argument when the routine's result matches it, or zero when it does not. It is short library code in icon.library.

name: verify_second_library_result
description: Calls a different library function with three arguments and returns the fourth argument when the result matches it, or zero otherwise. It has the same shape as its neighbour but uses another library entry.

name: exit_without_action
description: Returns immediately without any work. It is an empty routine in the shared icon.library on the disk.

name: divide_32_bit_unsigned
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a divisor and returns the quotient and remainder as a pair. A divisor above the 16-bit range uses a sixteen-step shift-and-subtract loop, while a smaller divisor uses direct 16-bit division.

name: shift_subtract_divide_loop
description: Runs a sixteen-step shift-and-subtract loop that divides the value in the low register by a divisor, leaving the quotient and remainder in registers. It is the core loop of the wider division code.

name: multiply_32_bit_values
description: Multiplies two 32-bit register values using 16-bit partial products and returns the combined 32-bit result. It also returns the second value with its two 16-bit halves swapped.

name: call_raw_format_function
description: Calls the exec text formatting function, RawDoFmt, through the library base held in a global variable, using arguments the caller has already placed in registers. It returns nothing.

name: measure_string_length
description: Counts the characters of a null-terminated string using a 16-bit counter, stopping at the terminator or when the counter runs out. It returns the count as the string length.

name: find_character_in_string
description: Scans a null-terminated string for a given character and returns a pointer to its first occurrence. It returns zero if the terminator is reached first.

name: return_zero_status
description: Returns the constant zero and does nothing else. It is a trivial routine in the shared icon.library on the disk.

name: copy_c_string
description: Copies bytes from a source string to a destination buffer, including the terminating zero byte, advancing both pointers until the terminator has been copied.

name: append_c_string
description: Advances to the terminating zero of the destination string, then copies the source string into that position, including its own terminator.

name: compare_bounded_strings
description: Compares two strings byte by byte for at most a given count, returning one as soon as they differ. It returns zero when the count runs out or both strings end at the same point.

name: return_one_status
description: Returns the constant one and does nothing else. It is a trivial routine in the shared icon.library on the disk.

name: walk_string_up_to_count
description: Walks a string for up to a given number of characters, and when it reaches the terminating zero it calls a library routine to handle the end of the string. It returns without a value.

name: forward_call_no_result
description: Calls one library routine with no arguments and returns, discarding any result. It is a minimal forwarding routine in icon.library.

name: copy_string_with_padding
description: Copies a string into a buffer of a given size, stopping after the terminating zero, then fills the rest of the buffer with zero bytes. It returns nothing.

name: return_without_effect
description: Returns immediately with no effect. It is an empty routine in the shared icon.library on the disk.

name: initialize_list_header_node
description: Sets the first longword of a block to point just past its start, clears the next longword, and stores the block's own address in the third longword. It prepares a self-referencing list header.

name: process_icon_request
description: Returns one when given no entry. Otherwise it checks the entry through a library routine and, if that succeeds, passes a value read from the entry's pointer field to a further routine, returning that routine's result.

name: process_entry_list_nodes
description: Walks a linked list of entries through their next field, running a library check on each entry and then a second routine with the entry's pointer and a size taken from a byte field. It returns one when the whole list succeeds and zero on the first failure.

name: check_entry_chain_pair
description: Walks a chain of entries through their next link, calling two library routines on each one. It returns one when the chain ends without a failure and zero as soon as either routine fails.

name: return_zero_result
description: Returns the constant zero without any other work. It is an empty stub in the shared icon.library on the disk.

name: allocate_and_fill_entry
description: Allocates a cleared twenty-byte block and fills it through library routines, storing a value from a library call in its pointer-sized field. It returns zero when the flag argument is zero, minus one when the allocation or a later step fails, and otherwise the block.

name: return_minus_one_status
description: Returns minus one with no other work. It is an empty stub in the shared icon.library on the disk.

name: build_entry_chain
description: Allocates cleared entries one at a time, linking each new entry to the previous one through its next field and filling it through library calls. It returns the first entry of the chain, or minus one when an allocation or setup step fails.

name: fill_entry_chain_fields
description: Walks a chain of entries, linking each to the previous one and filling its pointer field through library calls. It returns the first entry when the chain ends, and minus one if any step fails.

name: fill_entries_from_stack
description: Stores a pointer argument into each entry's link field, then fills entries through library calls until one has no further link. It returns the first entry, and minus one when any step fails.

name: return_error_status
description: Returns minus one with no other work. It is an empty stub in the shared icon.library on the disk.

name: return_minus_one_stub
description: Returns minus one and performs no other work. It is a two-instruction stub found in a runtime memory segment of the game.

name: return_immediately_stub
description: Returns immediately without any work. It is a one-instruction stub found in a runtime memory segment of the game.

name: copy_header_then_invoke_callback
description: Copies sixteen longwords from a fixed offset of the state structure into the buffer whose pointer is passed on the stack, skipping the copy when that pointer is null. It then calls a stored function pointer and returns nothing.

name: free_block_and_clear_slot
description: Runs an initial sequence of routine calls, including a delay loop through a called routine, then frees a memory block through the exec library and clears a stored slot. It returns a register pair and is the entry sequence of the install program.

name: release_resources_on_exit
description: Repeats the same call sequence as the install entry: several routine calls, a call through a function pointer from the global base, a memory release through exec, a cleared slot, and a returned register pair.

name: decode_compressed_bitstream
description: Decodes a compressed bit stream by clearing a sixteen-entry table, reading symbol codes through shift and lookup routines, and copying earlier output bytes to reproduce repeated runs. Afterwards it builds further tables and accumulates counts into them.

name: poll_until_zero_then_return
description: Calls three routines, repeatedly calls another routine until it returns zero, then calls three more routines and returns the value held in a register.

name: render_text_then_await_input
description: Opens the system libraries and disables interrupts and sprite DMA, then renders a text string into screen bitplanes by copying glyph rows and handling control codes for spacing and line breaks. It waits on a button or disk-status bit, then re-enables interrupts and DMA.

name: wait_until_flag_clear
description: Repeatedly calls a routine until the value it leaves in a register becomes zero, then returns. It is a polling wait.

name: wait_for_zero_result
description: Calls a routine repeatedly until the value it leaves in a register is zero, then returns. Its loop is the same as that of its neighbouring polling routine.

name: step_values_toward_targets
description: Advances a stepped transition by one unit. When its step counter reaches the final value it returns minus one; otherwise it moves several arrays of 16-bit values toward target values by a fixed step, then returns zero.

name: return_nothing_immediately
description: Returns immediately without doing anything. The body is a bare return in the FLT.1995 segment.

name: return_bare_routine
description: Returns immediately with no work. The routine body is a bare return.

name: return_no_operation_stub
description: Returns immediately with no effect. It is an empty stub in the FLT.1995 segment.

name: restore_custom_chip_state
description: Writes saved DMA control, interrupt request and interrupt enable values back to the custom chip registers with the set bit, stores a copper list pointer from a saved structure, and then calls the exec Permit routine to re-enable multitasking.

name: disable_all_custom_interrupts
description: Writes the all-bits-clear mask to the DMA control, interrupt enable and interrupt request registers, switching off every DMA channel and interrupt source. It returns nothing.

name: return_no_op_stub
description: Returns immediately with no effect and makes no register writes. It is a two-instruction routine.

name: open_graphics_and_init_display
description: Forbids multitasking and opens the graphics library, saving three of its words, then enables DMA channels and writes display configuration values into the custom chip registers. It returns nothing.

name: wait_for_status_byte_sequence
description: Polls a status byte at a fixed offset from the base register, first waiting for it to read as all ones and then waiting for it to read as the letter X. It returns when both conditions hold.

name: set_bitplane_pointers
description: Stores four bitplane addresses, spaced at a fixed interval in memory, into a table as high and low halves, then points the copper list register at that table. It returns nothing.

name: start_command_in_background
description: Parses the command line, including a numeric stack-size option with a minimum value, then starts the requested command in the background with its output sent to the NIL device. It reports an invalid parameter message when the arguments do not parse and returns a status code.

name: report_command_not_found
description: Measures a name string, then uses two library output calls to write a 'can't find' message followed by that name.

name: run_entry_cleanup_sequence
description: Runs the entry sequence of the TEAM17 program: several routine calls, a call through a function pointer from the global base, a memory release through exec, a cleared slot, and a returned register pair.

name: spin_delay_loop
description: Counts a 16-bit value down from its starting value to minus one as a busy delay, then returns.

name: find_max_and_prepare_buffer
description: Walks a linked list to find the largest stored value, starting from a floor of 149, then allocates memory and writes an incrementing sequence of words into it. It stores the maximum and a pointer structure, copies sixteen longwords into the new block, and returns zero, or minus one when a step fails.

name: run_three_library_probes
description: Performs three steps, each taking a string or data address, clearing a byte through a pointer and storing a 16-bit result from a library call in a global field. It returns zero.

name: release_library_resources
description: Calls three routines, including wrappers for the exec FreeMem and CloseLibrary functions, and returns zero. It releases memory and library resources held by the program.

name: store_four_library_results
description: Calls four routines in turn and stores each returned longword into a fixed slot of the global data area. It returns nothing.

name: allocate_memory_with_bias
description: Allocates memory through the exec library and returns the block's address plus a fixed bias, or zero when the allocation fails.

name: retry_open_library_until_success
description: Repeatedly calls the exec OpenLibrary routine until it returns a non-zero library base, doing nothing else on each failed try. It returns nothing.

name: forward_single_call
description: Calls one routine and returns with no result. It is a minimal forwarding routine.

name: copy_block_and_terminate
description: Copies a block of the given length from a source pointer to a destination, moving eight bytes per step and then the remainder, and writes a terminating zero byte at the end. It returns nothing.

name: init_list_and_return_handler
description: Clears two global list fields, calls two routines in between, and returns the address of a handler routine.

name: poll_routine_until_flag
description: Repeatedly calls a routine until the processor's zero flag becomes set, then returns. It is a polling wait loop.

name: allocate_and_link_node
description: Allocates a node through the exec library and links it into a list held in a global slot, setting its size field and returning the address of its data area. If the allocation fails, it calls an error routine and returns nothing usable.

name: unlink_or_allocate_list_node
description: Searches a list for the node named by its argument, and when found unlinks it and frees it through the exec library. When the node is absent and a flag is clear, it allocates a new node and adds it at the head of the list.

name: find_last_list_node
description: Walks a singly linked list until it reaches the node whose link is zero, then stores that last node in a global slot. It returns nothing.

name: preserve_slot_around_calls
description: Saves a global slot, calls two routines, and then restores the slot to its saved value. It returns nothing.

name: restore_slot_after_calls
description: Keeps a global slot unchanged across two routine calls by saving and restoring it. It returns nothing.

name: allocate_node_after_head
description: Allocates a block through the exec library, links it after the head node of a list held in a global slot, and records its size field, then returns the address just past its header. If allocation fails, it calls an error routine.

name: unlink_node_then_free
description: Searches the list after its head for the node named by the argument and, when found, unlinks it and frees it through the exec library. When the node is absent and a flag is clear, it allocates a new node and links it in.

name: remove_entry_from_chain
description: Walks a chain of entries to find the one matching the second argument, then unlinks it and frees it through the exec library. If the chain ends without a match and a flag is clear, it allocates a fresh entry and links it in.

name: push_allocated_node
description: Allocates a node through the exec library, links it in front of the current list head, and clears its second field. If allocation fails it calls an error routine.

name: free_all_list_nodes
description: Detaches the list head, frees that node through the exec library, then frees each remaining node of the chain in turn. It returns nothing.

name: find_max_prepare_overlay_buffer
description: Finds the largest value in a linked list starting from a floor of 149, allocates memory and fills it with an increasing sequence of words, and stores the maximum and a pointer structure. It copies sixteen longwords into the new block and returns zero, or minus one when a step fails.

name: copy_header_then_call_pointer
description: Copies sixteen longwords from a fixed offset of the state structure into the buffer whose pointer is passed on the stack, skipping the copy when that pointer is null. It then calls a stored function pointer and returns nothing.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The body is a single unimplemented instruction marker, so the routine holds no recoverable behaviour. It is a stub in the mathtrans library file on the disk.

name: store_argument_in_slot
description: Stores its address argument into a global slot in the library data and returns. It is a one-line setter in the mathtrans library.

name: release_entry_if_unused
description: If the entry's usage count is zero, it unlinks the entry from its list, frees it through the exec library and returns a stored value. Otherwise it sets a flag bit in the entry and returns zero.

name: mark_entry_pending_release
description: Sets a flag bit in the entry's status byte so it is released later, and returns zero.

name: acquire_entry_reference
description: If the entry is not marked for release, it increments the entry's reference count and, on the first reference, opens the mathffp library and stores its base. It returns the entry, or minus one when the entry is marked for release.

name: release_entry_reference
description: Decrements the entry's reference count. When the count reaches zero and the entry is flagged for release it runs the release routine and returns its result, and when the count reaches zero it passes the stored library base to a close routine.

name: forward_call_then_return
description: Calls one routine and returns. It is a minimal forwarding routine in the mathtrans library.

name: compute_bitwise_square_root
description: Computes the square root of a positive input bit by bit, running a 23-step loop that sets one result bit per step where the trial remainder is non-negative. A zero input returns at once, a negative input passes control to an error routine, and the result is left in working registers.

name: divide_mantissa_with_rounding
description: Runs a bit-by-bit restoring division on the mantissa held in registers, adds a final rounding step, and returns the result packed with a small trailing field.

name: call_and_set_status_bits
description: Calls a library function at a fixed offset and one routine, then returns the result with one status bit cleared and another set.

name: run_math_operation_sequence
description: Makes a fixed sequence of nine library calls alternating among three math routines, leaving the outcome in the library's result registers. It returns nothing.

name: compare_values_with_status
description: Calls library routines to compare an operand, then branches on the comparison and the sign through a sequence of library calls, and returns the result with some status bits cleared.

name: compare_values_with_branch_status
description: Compares an operand through library routines and chooses one of several library call sequences by the comparison and sign, then returns the result with some status bits cleared.

name: select_sign_dependent_operation
description: Chooses one of a few library call sequences from the sign and a flag value, performs it, and returns the result with some status bits cleared.

name: dispatch_operation_by_flags
description: Chooses between a few library call sequences using a sign test and a zero test on two operand registers, then returns the result with status bits cleared.

name: finish_operation_with_status
description: Runs one library call selected by the sign test and the zero test, then returns the result with some status bits cleared.

name: invoke_math_routine_status
description: Calls one library function and returns its result with status bits cleared.

name: apply_math_call_pair_status
description: Calls the same library function twice, then one routine, and returns the result with some status bits cleared.

name: double_call_then_status
description: Calls one library function twice and returns the result of a routine with status bits cleared. It is the same sequence as its neighbour.

name: compute_bit_serial_quotient
description: Checks an exponent-like byte against a range and flags out-of-range inputs, then computes a bit-serial quotient over up to twenty-four steps. It calls an error routine when the steps run out or the input is out of range.

name: accumulate_bit_serial_quotient
description: Accumulates quotient bits from a bit-serial loop over up to twenty-four steps on the register value, and calls an error routine when the steps run out before the result is complete.

name: accumulate_bits_with_counter
description: Runs a bit-serial accumulation loop driven by a 16-bit counter, adding shifted values until the counter runs out, and then calls an error routine.

name: compute_cordic_trig_rotation
description: Reduces an angle argument by multiples of a half-turn constant, then runs a twenty-three-step CORDIC-style rotation that adds or subtracts table angles and shifted values. It passes the sine and cosine components to output routines and returns early for out-of-range arguments.

name: compute_cordic_trig_checked
description: Range-checks an angle argument, reduces it, and runs a CORDIC-style rotation loop with table angles. It then calls output routines, one of them only when the residual is non-zero.

name: compute_cordic_trig_short
description: Reduces an angle argument by multiples of a half-turn constant and runs a shorter CORDIC-style rotation loop, then calls an output routine. It returns early for out-of-range arguments.

name: compute_cordic_trig_output
description: Reduces an angle argument and runs a CORDIC-style rotation loop when the argument is in range, then calls output routines that depend on a sign and a mode value passed on the stack.

name: compute_cordic_angle_only
description: Range-checks an angle argument, reduces it, and runs a CORDIC-style loop that accumulates only the angle component, then calls an output routine.

name: compute_cordic_with_stack_mode
description: Reduces an angle argument, runs a twenty-three-step CORDIC-style rotation, and calls output routines chosen by a mode value passed on the stack. One branch checks whether the residual is zero.

name: compute_cordic_reduced_angle
description: Reduces an angle argument by repeatedly adding multiples of a constant, then runs a CORDIC-style rotation and finishes with output routines selected by a mode value on the stack.

name: compute_cordic_rotation_direct
description: Runs a CORDIC-style rotation loop directly on the angle argument without range reduction, then finishes with output routines selected by a mode value on the stack.

name: shift_add_multiply_loop
description: Runs a shift-and-add loop over a count held in a register, accumulating shifted values from a table, then finishes with output routines selected by a mode value on the stack.

name: return_empty_math_stub
description: Returns immediately without any work. It is an empty stub in the mathtrans library.

name: forward_call_pass_through
description: Calls one routine and returns. It is a minimal pass-through in the mathtrans library.

name: call_two_routines_in_turn
description: Calls two routines one after the other and returns. It is a minimal sequencing routine in the mathtrans library.

name: normalize_float_mantissa
description: Normalizes a value held in a register by shifting it left until its top bit is set, adjusting an exponent word for each shift, with a separate path for negative values. Zero and values that already fit the range are left unchanged.

name: normalize_mantissa_if_needed
description: Returns at once when a stored byte passes a range check, otherwise normalizes a register value by shifting it left until its top bit is set and adjusts an exponent word for each shift. A zero value is left unchanged.

name: call_three_routines_unconditionally
description: Calls one routine and then two more in sequence, behind a flag that is always clear, so the later calls always run. It returns nothing.

name: call_four_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls one routine and then three more, behind a flag that is always clear, so the later calls always run. It returns nothing.

name: call_chain_for_nonzero_byte
description: When a byte argument is non-zero and incrementing it does not overflow, it calls a routine and then calls two routines with the incremented value and one more. It returns nothing otherwise.

name: return_immediately_section_four
description: Returns immediately with no work. It is an empty stub in the fourth code section of the mathtrans library.

name: return_no_op_section_stub
description: Returns immediately with no work. It is an empty stub in the fourth code section of the mathtrans library.

name: return_empty_section_five

name: prepare_float_digits
description: Returns at once for a zero value. Otherwise it computes a shift from the exponent byte, shifts the mantissa into a small buffer when the shift is in range, and calls library routines to process the digits and round them.

name: call_four_setup_routines
description: Calls four routines one after another and returns. It is a minimal sequencing routine in the mathtrans library.

name: accumulate_signed_series
description: Walks an array for a count held in a register, adding each value to a running total while the total is negative and subtracting it otherwise. It returns nothing.

name: accumulate_series_pre_add
description: Adds the first array value to a running total, then walks the rest, subtracting values while the total is non-negative and adding them when it is negative, until the count is used up. It returns nothing.

name: scale_and_normalize_value
description: Returns for a zero value. For a positive value it runs a bit-serial division loop with an error path; otherwise it normalizes the mantissa by shifting it left up to a fixed limit and calls two routines to finish.

name: return_immediately_section_six
description: Returns immediately with no work. It is an empty stub in the sixth code section of the mathtrans library.

name: divide_and_normalize_value
description: Runs a bit-serial division loop with an error path on its input unless a flag is set, then normalizes the mantissa by shifting it left up to a fixed limit and calls two routines to finish.

name: bit_serial_divide_normalize
description: Runs a bit-serial division loop driven by a 16-bit counter and calls an error routine when the counter runs out, then normalizes the result by shifting it left up to a fixed limit and calls two routines. A zero exponent returns at once.

name: call_three_setup_routines
description: Calls three routines one after another and returns. It is a minimal sequencing routine in the mathtrans library.

name: pack_float_into_stack_word
description: Handles the sign and exponent of a value: a negative value takes one path, while a non-zero positive value is shifted into a small stack word, made positive when needed, and finished by library routines. Zero returns at once.

name: pack_nonnegative_float_word
description: For a non-zero value, shifts the mantissa into a small stack word using its exponent, makes the word positive when needed, and calls library routines to finish the pack. It returns nothing.
